interpretation: Hub-first added one independent opportunity week to the legacy 2021 calendar (+25.0%).
The incremental China Tourism Group Duty Free selection was positive and beat CSI300 over 60 trading days.
The combined 2021 sample modestly improved positive hit rate from 66.7% to 70.0% and excess-win rate from 77.8% to 80.0%.
The incremental idea suffered a large interim drawdown, so discovery recall improved more clearly than timing quality.

Together with the independently constructed 2022 proxy result, this is cross-year evidence that generalist-hub discovery can increase opportunity recall without changing the underwriting rules, but the sample remains exploratory and small.
